name: Ras Pipari Ras

sections.introduction: Ras Pipari Ras is classical preparation that balances Kapha and Vata. This is Ayurvedic medicine having with herbal and mineral ingredients, in tablet form. Effective Ayurvedic medicine to be used in pediatric conditions like rhinitis, cold, cough, vomiting etc.
sections.ingredients:
Parada (Purified and processed Mercury) 
 Gandhaka (Purified and processed Sulphur) 
 Trikatu (Pepper, Long pepper and Ginger) 
 Karkata shrungi ( Pistacia chinensis ) 
 Ativisha (Aconitum heterophyllum) 
 Musta (Cyperus rotundus) 
 Mocharasa (Bombax malabaricum) 
 Jatiphala (Jatipatra) ( Myrisitca fragrans ) –  Leaves and fruit of nutmeg 
 Tankana (Processed Borax) 
 Pippali (Long pepper) 
 Svarna Bhasma (Gold Bhasma) – 1 gram 
 Mukta Bhasma (Bhasma of Pearl) – 2 grams 
 Purified Cinnaba –  (An ore of Mercury and suphur) – 3 grams 
 Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Kharpara (Rasaka) – 8 grams 
 Trikatu – Pepper, long pepper and ginger 
 Tamra bhasma – Copper calx 
 Loha Bhasma – Iron calx 
 Kantakari rasa ( Solanum xanthocarpum ) Juice extract 
 Dhattura rasa ( Datura metel ) Juice extract 
 Katuki rasa ( Picrorhiza kurroa ) Juice extract 

 Method of Preparation 
 Grind all these ingredients – Parada, Gandhaka, Trikatu, Karkata shrungi, Ativisha, Musta, Mocharasa, Jatiphala, Tankan, Pippal, Svarna Bhasma, Mukta Bhasma, Maricha and Kharpara with lemon juice. Now grind Trikatu, Tamra bhasma and Loha Bhasma with Kantakari rasa, Dhattura rasa and Katuki rasa and make the tablets.
sections.dosage: Consume 1/2-1 tablets (125 mg) 1-2 times a day before or after having meals or as recommended by Ayurvedic doctor and it can be administered along with honey.
sections.therapeutic_uses:
Useful Ayurvedic therapy for cold, cough, rhinitis, vomiting, diarrhea and fever in children. 
 Also useful in Teething problems.
sections.contraindications_side_effects:
This Ayurvedic medicine must be consumed under strict directions only. 
 Its self-medication might be unsafe. 
 It’s over dose might result in side effects like tremors, dizziness etc. 
 Have this medicine under recommended dose and specified period of time. 
 Keep it away from the reach and sight of children. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Ras Pipari Ras 
 Introduction 
 Ras Pipari Ras is classical preparation that balances Kapha and Vata. This is Ayurvedic medicine having with herbal and mineral ingredients, in tablet form. Effective Ayurvedic medicine to be used in pediatric conditions like rhinitis, cold, cough, vomiting etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Parada (Purified and processed Mercury) 
 Gandhaka (Purified and processed Sulphur) 
 Trikatu (Pepper, Long pepper and Ginger) 
 Karkata shrungi ( Pistacia chinensis ) 
 Ativisha (Aconitum heterophyllum) 
 Musta (Cyperus rotundus) 
 Mocharasa (Bombax malabaricum) 
 Jatiphala (Jatipatra) ( Myrisitca fragrans ) –  Leaves and fruit of nutmeg 
 Tankana (Processed Borax) 
 Pippali (Long pepper) 
 Svarna Bhasma (Gold Bhasma) – 1 gram 
 Mukta Bhasma (Bhasma of Pearl) – 2 grams 
 Purified Cinnaba –  (An ore of Mercury and suphur) – 3 grams 
 Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Kharpara (Rasaka) – 8 grams 
 Trikatu – Pepper, long pepper and ginger 
 Tamra bhasma – Copper calx 
 Loha Bhasma – Iron calx 
 Kantakari rasa ( Solanum xanthocarpum ) Juice extract 
 Dhattura rasa ( Datura metel ) Juice extract 
 Katuki rasa ( Picrorhiza kurroa ) Juice extract 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Grind all these ingredients – Parada, Gandhaka, Trikatu, Karkata shrungi, Ativisha, Musta, Mocharasa, Jatiphala, Tankan, Pippal, Svarna Bhasma, Mukta Bhasma, Maricha and Kharpara with lemon juice. Now grind Trikatu, Tamra bhasma and Loha Bhasma with Kantakari rasa, Dhattura rasa and Katuki rasa and make the tablets. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 1/2-1 tablets (125 mg) 1-2 times a day before or after having meals or as recommended by Ayurvedic doctor and it can be administered along with honey. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Useful Ayurvedic therapy for cold, cough, rhinitis, vomiting, diarrhea and fever in children. 
 Also useful in Teething problems. 
 
 Contraindications / Side Effects 
 
 This Ayurvedic medicine must be consumed under strict directions only. 
 Its self-medication might be unsafe. 
 It’s over dose might result in side effects like tremors, dizziness etc. 
 Have this medicine under recommended dose and specified period of time. 
 Keep it away from the reach and sight of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
